Ivy (CS): Delta customer onboarding cutover is scheduled for TOMORROW 07:00 UTC. Scope: reserved pool activation, staggered regional ramp (us-west -> eu-west), autoscale tuning, and a short customer feedback check-in 1h after go-live. Who can monitor and post updates to the customer channel during the first 90m?

Marco (Infra): Ill own infra handoff and reservation. Pool: pool-delta-01, template=reserved-a100v4-mix, slots=10, spare=2. Reservation ticket created (RES-3421). Will run warmup at 06:50 UTC.

Ravi (SE): I can do canary + staged load. Plan: us-west 5% for 10m -> 20% for 20m -> eu-west mirror at 10% then ramp. Will run synthetic dialog tests for quality checks. Need canary key and KMS unseal window 06:45-07:15 UTC.

Zoe (SRE): Autoscale baseline suggestion: min_replicas=3, target_util=58%, max_replicas=16, scale_up_cooldown=100s. Use queue_length AND latency p95 as dual signals; set queue_threshold=1300. Add circuit breaker: if error_rate > 1% for 3m, shift 25% to hosted fallback and pause ramp.

Ivy (CS): Customer asked for a one-time warmup credit and a post-cutover feedback form. Ill capture the renewal note (health=neutral, flagged for renewal team). Who will post the feedback link?

Marco (Infra): Warmup commands and reservation snippet: 

Marco (Infra): ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool pool-delta-01 --slots 10 --duration 6h --note "delta-cutover-RES-3421"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool pool-delta-01 --profile warm-cache --concurrency 8
```

ops-bot: Scheduled load job id=1849991111-load for 2026-06-10T07:05:00Z by @Ravi. Load logs will post to thread.

Ravi (SE): Smoke curl (will replace real token at run):

Ravi (SE): ```
curl -s -X POST https://delta.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

Zoe (SRE): Fallback model prepared: hosted-quantized-lite. Routing policy: region=eu-west -> fallback=hosted-quantized-lite if p95 > 400ms or errors spike. Alerts: quota@85% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall; latency_p95@350ms -> #eng-sre.

Ivy (CS): Thanks team. Final pre-cutover checklist: 1) KMS unseal confirmed (Marco) 2) Canary key issued (Ravi) 3) Reservation & warmup done (Marco) 4) Runbook + rollback snippet visible in RES-3421 (Zoe) 5) Billing buffer noted (Ivy). Please DM if blocked. Ill post the customer-facing status updates if someone can paste short perf snapshots every 10m. :white_check_mark:
